1.web: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
1.asv: Give the king thy judgments, O God, And thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

2.web: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
2.asv: He will judge thy people with righteousness, And thy poor with justice.

3.web: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
3.asv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, And the hills, in righteousness.

4.web: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
4.asv: He will judge the poor of the people, He will save the children of the needy, And will break in pieces the oppressor.

5.web: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
5.asv: They shall fear thee while the sun endureth, And so long as the moon, throughout all generations.

6.web: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
6.asv: He will come down like rain upon the mown grass, As showers that water the earth.

7.web: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
7.asv: In his days shall the righteous flourish, And abundance of peace, till the moon be no more.

8.web: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
8.asv: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, And from the River unto the ends of the earth.

9.web: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
9.asv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; And his enemies shall lick the dust.

10.web: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
10.asv: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall render tribute: The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

11.web: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
11.asv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him; All nations shall serve him.

12.web: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
12.asv: For he will deliver the needy when he crieth, And the poor, that hath no helper.

13.web: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
13.asv: He will have pity on the poor and needy, And the souls of the needy he will save.

14.web: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
14.asv: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence; And precious will their blood be in his sight:

15.web: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
15.asv: And they shall live; and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: And men shall pray for him continually; They shall bless him all the day long.

16.web: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
16.asv: There shall be abundance of grain in the earth upon the top of the mountains; The fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: And they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

17.web: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
17.asv: His name shall endure for ever; His name shall be continued as long as the sun: And men shall be blessed in him; All nations shall call him happy.

18.web: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
18.asv: Blessed be Jehovah God, the God of Israel, Who only doeth wondrous things:

19.web: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
19.asv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever; And let the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen, and Amen.

20.web: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
20.asv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
